alerts.allowed_root: Intended: the developer-configured example file set (interface.examples). Actual: none - file_name is passed to open() verbatim, so absolute paths and any relative path are accepted.
alerts.actual_operation: Arbitrary local file READ. The bytes are returned (inputs.py:1181) into the prediction pipeline; a pass-through predict function returns them in the /api/predict response, and even without echo the read itself occurs.
alerts.traversal_feasibility: Real: absolute path (e.g. '/etc/passwd' or 'C:\\...'), '..'-relative paths, and repeated separators all reach open() unmodified. No URL decoding is needed (the value arrives via JSON body).
alerts.barrier_check: None. No normpath/realpath/resolve, no root containment, no whitelist of example names, no basename reduction; is_example is trusted from the client. login_check is a no-op by default. This is not a case of misreading a Path.resolve/startsWith/auth check as protection (question 7): there simply is no check.
alerts.preconditions: Interface has a File input component with type='bytes' (non-default; default type is 'file'); crafted POST /api/predict JSON with is_example=true. Public sharing link makes this network-reachable.
alerts.rationale: 真实的请求可控路径直达 open() 的任意文件读取。Source（请求 JSON 的 name/is_example 字段）、传播链（Flask -> Interface.process -> File.preprocess -> process_single_file）与 Sink（open 'rb' 并把内容送回预测管道）均有真实源码证据，全程无校验/Barrier。属于越权文件读取（CWE-22/36），非正常静态文件服务或测试代码。

alerts.actual_operation: File CREATE inside the system temp dir; the created name is <client-controlled basename stem><8 random chars>. The subsequent file_obj.write(data) writes client-provided content at a server-chosen temp path.
alerts.traversal_feasibility: Not achievable: prefix derives from os.path.basename(file_path) (processing_utils.py:141), which strips all '/' (posixpath) and, on Windows, also '\\' (ntpath). A separator-free prefix cannot move the created file out of the temp dir; '..' as a prefix only yields a literal odd filename (random body always appended).
alerts.barrier_check: os.path.basename is not a taint barrier (taint propagates, as CodeQL correctly models), but it is an effective traversal barrier here because the tainted value is used only as a filename component after separator stripping. tempfile's random 8-char body and O_EXCL further constrain the final name.
alerts.preconditions: Interface with Video/Audio/File input; POST /api/predict with a non-example file entry (or any entry, since the value only feeds the temp-file name).
alerts.rationale: 污点流真实（请求 name 字段确实到达 tempfile prefix），但该值在 processing_utils.py:141 已经过 os.path.basename，分隔符被剥离，prefix 只能影响 /tmp 内文件名的字面前缀，无法越出临时目录。按问题 3/5 的标准，这里不存在可达的越权访问目标；Sink 本质是文件名拼接而非可穿越的路径参数。判定为假阳性（过度泛化 Sink：把文件名构造当作路径穿越 Sink）。

source_analysis.evidence: Two families: (a) flagging flow - component.py:48-51 save_flagged_file(data) -> decode_base64_to_file(data, encryption_key) with file_path=None, so extension falls back to mime_extension (processing_utils.py:147) which is parsed from the client-controlled data-URI header (processing_utils.py:124-135, header[header.index('/')+1:]) with NO separator filtering; (b) preprocess flow - extension from os.path.basename(file_path) (processing_utils.py:141-145), separator-free.

alerts.taint_flow: (a) flag_data (networking.py:276, fed by /api/predict auto-flag 212-214 and /api/flag 354-360) / Image.save_flagged (inputs.py:863-867) / Video.save_flagged (inputs.py:941-945) -> Component.save_flagged_file data (component.py:48) -> decode_base64_to_file encoding (processing_utils.py:137) -> decode_base64_to_binary -> mime_extension (124-135, 138) -> extension (147) -> suffix (151). (b) as in A2/A3 through 141-145.
alerts.actual_operation: File CREATE via tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile with client-influenced suffix; content is the client's decoded base64 payload (file_obj.write at processing_utils.py:154).
alerts.traversal_feasibility: Not achievable in practice. Family (b) is basename-filtered. Family (a) does carry an unfiltered, separator-capable string into suffix, but CPython tempfile constructs the candidate name as dir + prefix + 8 RANDOM CHARS + suffix and opens with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, retrying only on FileExistsError. A suffix containing '/' or '\\' (e.g. './../../../etc/x') yields a path whose intermediate component is the nonexistent random body, so the open fails with ENOENT/FileNotFoundError and the request errors out - no file is created outside the temp dir. A separator-free suffix cannot traverse; O_EXCL additionally prevents clobbering. Null bytes raise ValueError. Windows path resolution fails identically on the missing intermediate component.
alerts.barrier_check: No explicit barrier for family (a) - the containment is emergent from tempfile's random-mid-body name construction plus O_EXCL. This is a genuine code-hygiene gap (unfiltered client header reaching a filename component) but not a traversable path.
alerts.preconditions: Flagging enabled (default) and a crafted /api/predict or /api/flag payload with a malicious data-URI header; or a Video/Audio/File preprocess payload for family (b).
alerts.rationale: 唯一真正未过滤的污点（flagging 流中来自 data-URI 头的 mime_extension，可含分隔符）确实进入 tempfile suffix，但 tempfile 的随机中段命名 + O_EXCL 使含分隔符的 suffix 在路径解析时因中段随机目录不存在而失败（仅捕获 FileExistsError），实际无法在临时目录外创建/覆盖文件；basename 流则完全不可穿越。按问题 5 的标准，'..' 与分隔符不真实影响访问目标。判为假阳性，但记录为低危加固项（应对 extension 做字符过滤）。若后续 Python tempfile 语义变化或平台路径解析异常，此判定需复查。

global_checklist_answers.q1_source_attacker_controlled: All 8 alerts trace to genuine request-controlled values: the /api/predict, /api/interpret and /api/flag JSON bodies (component 'name'/'data'/'is_example' fields) reaching preprocess/save_flagged parameters (networking.py:192/358/368 -> interface.py:363-370 -> inputs.py). None originate from route URL paths in this result set (the /file and /static route sources produced no alerts).
global_checklist_answers.q2_flow_real: Yes for all 8 - the codeFlows match real call edges (preprocess -> process_single_file -> decode_base64_to_file / create_tmp_copy_of_file; save_flagged -> save_flagged_file -> decode_base64_to_file). Async/wrapping hops are all statically present in the sources.
global_checklist_answers.q3_sink_sensitive: A1 (open 'rb') and A8 (shutil.copy2 source) are genuine sensitive reads. A2-A7 are tempfile prefix/suffix keyword arguments - filename construction rather than a traversable path argument; the actual file creation stays inside the system temp dir.
global_checklist_answers.q4_allowed_roots: Declared/implicit roots: system temp dir (tempfile), flagging dir (developer config, charset-filtered label), STATIC_PATH_LIB (safe_join contained), app.cwd (/file route, not represented in this alert set). For A1/A8 there is effectively NO enforced root - the example-set intent is unenforced, so controlled input points outside it trivially.
global_checklist_answers.q5_traversal_factors: For A1/A8: absolute paths, '..' and separator variants all work verbatim (JSON transport, single decode, no symlinks involved). For A2/A3/A5/A6/A7: basename strips separators before use. For A4: the unfiltered data-URI header extension can carry separators into tempfile suffix, but the random mid-path component makes such paths unresolvable (ENOENT), so traversal does not materialize; percent-decoding is irrelevant (no URL decode of these values server-side).
global_checklist_answers.q6_real_barriers: safe_join (networking.py:143, /static route) is a genuine pre-access containment barrier, but no alert in this set passes through it. The component.py:52 label charset filter guards the flagging subdir name (developer label, not request data). No strict post-normalization root containment exists on the A1/A8 paths.
global_checklist_answers.q7_misread_protections: None of the 8 alerts relies on misreading Path.resolve/normpath/startsWith/login as protection. (Noted for completeness: the /file route's secure_filename at networking.py:380 is an unimported name - not a barrier - and path.startswith(examples) at :381 is a non-normalized prefix check on the encrypted branch only; neither appears in the alert set.)
global_checklist_answers.q8_benign_cases: A1/A8 are live request-handling paths, not authorized static serving, tests, unreachable code or constants. A2-A7 touch live code but the values cannot redirect the access target outside the temp dir.
global_checklist_answers.q9_overgeneralization: The 6 tempfile findings (A2-A7) are the classic over-generalized-sink pattern: the label set (K03-K06) treats tempfile name components as traversal sinks; with basename-derived values (and tempfile's random mid-body for the one unfiltered path) they cannot escape. This, not a database coverage gap or wrong diagnostic path, is the FP cause.
global_checklist_answers.q10_purity: Confirmed: single rule, single run, 8 results, all py/augur/gradio/pass1-path-traversal; no baseline, diagnostics or built-in query results are counted.

real_vulnerability_match.task: Compare the official Pass 1 alerts against the real project vulnerability (PyVul ground truth, provided by the operator for this separate task only).

ground_truth.note: The DB snapshot's networking.py:379-388 matches the commit's code_before verbatim (secure_filename(path) + open/send_file(os.path.join(app.cwd, path))). Additionally, in this snapshot secure_filename is not imported anywhere in gradio/networking.py (imports at lines 5-30 include only safe_join from werkzeug.security), so as written the route would raise NameError; with the import present (as in the released gradio<2.4.8), the route serves any file under app.cwd.

real_vulnerability_match.evidence: None of the 8 official Pass 1 results is located in gradio/networking.py or in the file()/static_resource() routes. All 8 results are in gradio/inputs.py and gradio/processing_utils.py, on the component preprocess/flagging flows.
real_vulnerability_match.reason_for_miss: The S64 (file route path parameter) -> K35/K44 (open/send_file on os.path.join(app.cwd, path)) taint flow was suppressed by the dead reassignment 'path = secure_filename(path)' at networking.py:380: secure_filename is an unresolved name in the database, Python taint tracking has no argument->result step for unresolved calls, so the tainted parameter never reaches the later uses of the rebound 'path'. This was documented in advance as limitation L1 in report/query_generation_notes.md. The flow is suppressed by the dead reassignment, not by any real sanitization.
other_real_vulnerabilities: A1 gradio/inputs.py:1180: arbitrary file read via File.preprocess type='bytes' is_example branch (client-set is_example + unvalidated name -> open 'rb').

A8 gradio/processing_utils.py:168: arbitrary file read/copy via create_tmp_copy_of_file (client-set is_example + unvalidated name -> shutil.copy2 source), reachable with the default File type='file' and with Video/Audio components.
real_vulnerability_match.verdict: 本轮正式 Pass 1 告警未命中 ground-truth 修复提交 41bd3645 所针对的 file() 路由漏洞（/file/<path:path>，networking.py:377-388）——该污点路径因 secure_filename 死赋值被抑制（L1）。但告警命中了同一漏洞快照中另外两处真实存在的同 CWE 类任意文件读取（inputs.py:1180 与 processing_utils.py:168，根因均为 is_example + 未校验 name 字段）。若以'命中项目真实存在的漏洞'为标准：命中了真实存在的其他漏洞，未命中该修复提交指定的漏洞函数；若以'命中修复提交对应漏洞'为标准：未命中（miss）。
